body.title: The team inside the site, on Mistral: seven roles on pipeline-demo (every role on mistral-small-2603)
body.story: The seven roles of "A website with a team inside" (Dinis Cruz, 19 November 2026), each doing its job on a real public site in the family, on Mistral models only. Nothing is pushed to the site: the edit is a proposal for its owner. Every role on mistral-small-2603, to compare with the tiered run.

edit.reason: The heading is too vague and does not indicate that these are the fields to complete.

suggestions.what: Add a clear heading hierarchy (e.g., H1 for the page title, H2 for "The fields", "Groups", and "People and privacy")
suggestions.why: Improves readability by structuring content into logical sections for a first-time visitor.

suggestions.what: Convert the "Field Rule" section into a bulleted list for easier scanning
suggestions.why: Bullet points make the rules clearer and less intimidating than a table format for quick understanding.

suggestions.what: Separate the "Groups" section with more vertical spacing and a subheading (e.g., "Available site groups")
suggestions.why: Distinguishes the list of groups from other content and makes it stand out as a key reference.
